exposure: Ultrasound-guided Transversus Abdominis Plane (TAP) block with local anesthetic
cohort: 140 women undergoing elective caesarean section were randomly assigned to either receive an ultrasound-guided TAP block or a sham procedure.
finding: Ultrasound-guided TAP block significantly reduced pain scores, opioid consumption, and opioid-related side effects, while improving maternal satisfaction and accelerating recovery milestones after caesarean section.
mod_finding: Ultrasound-guided TAP block is an effective technique for post-caesarean pain management, improving analgesia and recovery for women undergoing caesarean delivery.
